name: @qf-jarvis/conversation-control
description: QF Jarvis conversation control command foundation (QFJ-P08-A, ADR-0074). A strict, content-free, revision-bound operator command contract and a PURE deterministic reducer for TAKE_OWNERSHIP, RELEASE_OWNERSHIP, PAUSE_AI and RESUME_AI. It answers only 'given this validated control fragment and this validated command, what is the deterministic next fragment and safe audit evidence?' -- it stores nothing, makes nothing authoritative, and is composed into no runtime. Taking ownership forces AI paused; releasing ownership never resumes AI; resuming is a distinct explicit action refused while a human holds the conversation (ADR-0054 E). No persistence, no durable idempotency, no port, no HTTP, no UI, no consent, no approval, no transport, no provider, no Core, no clock, no randomness. Depends on zod only.
